summary: Nomura Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a supplement for financial highlights for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The report provides unaudited consolidated financial results under U.S. GAAP, including net revenue of 2,167.7 billion yen, net income attributable to shareholders of 362.1 billion yen, and return on equity of 10.1%. It also includes balance sheet and capital adequacy data. This is a routine earnings update, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any risk-arb or corporate event analysis.
